title: Ocean DR Segway Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover Miami’s vibrant South Beach like never before with our Ocean Drive Segway Tour! Glide effortlessly along the iconic Ocean Drive, where stunning Art Deco architecture meets the dazzling Atlantic coastline. Our expert guides will lead you past famous landmarks, lush palm-lined streets, and the lively energy of South Beach, all while sharing fascinating stories and historical insights. Feel the breeze on your face as you soak in the unparalleled views and atmosphere of one of Miami’s most renowned locales. This tour offers a perfect blend of fun, education, and sightseeing—an unforgettable way to experience the heart of Miami. Book now and make your visit to South Beach truly memorable!
